text:
jess: Quick follow-up from today's RFC sync — we launched the migration adapters in staging and hit two behavioral gaps with the shim: one around header promotion when clients send both X-Client-Version and X-Forwarded-Version, and one around streaming EOF handling for legacy chunked responses.

omar: I saw the logs, thx. The header promotion thing looks like a tie-breaker bug — adapters prefer X-Forwarded-Version but some SDKs set both. Should we canonicalize to prefer the most-specific (client) header? @tia any thoughts from SDK side? :thinking_face: 

tia: SDKs historically wrote X-Client-Version for telemetry; we recently added X-Forwarded-Version in the agent. We can flip to only set one, but that's a release on our side. For the shim, I'd rather we normalize: if both present, prefer X-Client-Version and add a debug tag so we can backtrack.

max: Agreed on normalization. Proposal: adapter rule: if both headers exist, choose X-Client-Version, and emit a shim-mapped tag in request metadata: `shim.version_edge=client_vers_preferred`. That way telemetry can filter weird hits.

jess: Sounds good. For the streaming EOF issue — legacy clients end stream with a zero-length chunk, our runtime treats that as an error frame in some paths. We should make the adapter swallow the trailing empty chunk and send a clean `stream_end` event.

omar: Implementation detail: change adapter's chunk parser to treat an empty chunk after data as EOF rather than a protocol error. I'll open a tiny PR. Should we add a compatibility test in the contract suite?

tia: Yes please. Add a test variant that simulates a legacy chunked stream with final `

` (empty chunk). It should assert we return `stream_end` not `err_protocol`.

platform-bot: deploybot: Canary deploy of adapters/shim v1.3.2 -> staging succeeded (12/12 pods). Link: https://deploys.redwood.dev/sha/abcd1234 :rocket:

lia: Also flagging operational rollbacks: let's add a soft-rollback flag `adapter.disable_shim_v1_3_2=true` to the infra runbooks so support can toggle without code changes. We had to do that last time and it saved the day.

max: Good call. I'll add the runbook snippet and the flag to the canary dashboard.

omar: PR opened: https://git.redwood/infra/adapter-shim/pull/482 — includes header normalization, chunk-tolerant parser, and a new contract test file `compat/legacy_chunk_eof.test`. CI green locally.

jess: Nice. Can we also add a brief compatibility note in the migration doc pointing out the header tie-breaker? Non-obvious and likely to surface support tickets.

tia: I'll add a short blurb in the SDK changelog and an opt-in telemetry filter to help us identify clients still sending both headers.

jess: OK — action items summarized: 1) Omar merge small PR after two approvals; 2) Max add runbook + rollback flag; 3) Tia update SDK changelog & add contract test variant; 4) Lia add infra toggle to canary dashboard; 5) Jess update migration doc. Aim to ship to prod after one canary cycle tomorrow.

omar: thumbs up. I'll request reviews now. :+1:

lia: Logging a quick incident config entry so on-call sees potential noise from shim tags.

jess: Thanks team — ping me if anything blocks the canary.
